d: Theeran, a dedicated police officer, pays the price for his honesty and faces hardships when he tries to investigate the illegal activities conducted by a powerful gangster.
With two brains and two voices in one body. Abhiram faces chaos in love and life as Abhi and Ram struggle for control, testing his heart and identity along the way.
An anthology of stories wherein ardent devotees of Kartikeya, the Hindu god of war, overcome various obstacles and succeed in their lives with the Almighty's help.
